facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya published in December 2024 an analytical fact sheet of ICT uptake from the 2022 Kenya Demographic and Health Survey.
The 2022 KDHS fact sheet gives internet use in the past 12 months, aged 15-49, as 80.0% of urban and 40.7% of rural men and 67.7% of urban and 27.9% of rural women.

KEN.note: Internet use is given by sex for ages 15-49 only, with no all-population share.
Phone ownership is given by sex for ages 15-49 only, with no share of people aged 10 and over.
